newsitem.title: FINLAND: CULTOR SAYS BUYS ASCHAN OY BAKERY IN TURKU.
newsitem.headline: CULTOR SAYS BUYS ASCHAN OY BAKERY IN TURKU.

text.p: Finnish food, bakery and sweetener group Cultor Oy said in a statement on Monday its subsidiary Vaasan Leipomot had acquired Turku-based bakery Aschan Oy's operations from Primula Oy for an undisclosed sum.
In 1996, Aschan's net sales were about 40 million markka and it employed 100 people, Cultor said. The business would be transferred to Cultor on May 1, it added.
"As a result of the acquisition, Vaasan Leipomot's market position will strengthen significantly," it said.
"Significant operational benefits can be achieved through cooperation between Vaasan Leipomot's regional bakeries in Turku, Iso Heikkila and Aschan," Cultor said.
